title: PLVS Default
summary: The complete first-run monitoring workspace included with PLVS.
descriptionMarkdown: The built-in starting point for general monitoring. PLVS Default keeps all eight Workspace modules visible, uses PLVS Default as its Loudness Profile, retains the normal opaque window presentation, and leaves Dock off. A new PLVS installation saves this scene as the active PLVS Default Preset so it remains available after the workspace is rearranged.
